generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a small pool of realistic tokens; 5% of values are near-variants (case change, trailing space, doubled letter) of a pool value; NULL share per column statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.text_id: Sample an identifier-shaped string (letters+digits) unique within the column unless the column is a foreign key; 5% near-variants; NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.text_url: Sample 'http://' or 'https://' + host + path; 5% near-variants (http vs https, trailing slash); NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Sample a date string in %Y-%m-%d; NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.text_json: Sample a Python-dict-like string "{'start': 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'end': 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'party': '<party>'}"; NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_id: Sample an integer in [1, 10^6]; 5% near-variants (value +/- 1); NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.real_id: Sample a real in [1, 10^6] with one decimal; 5% near-variants (value +/- 1); NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.date_iso: Sample a date in %Y-%m-%d between 1730-01-01 and 2020-12-31; 5% near-variants (one day before/after a pool value); NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_small: Sample uniformly from the column's enum list; NULL share per statistics.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values: For every column, 5% of non-NULL values are fresh (not in the observed pool) to exercise DISTINCT and GROUP BY.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_reservation: For every column listed in per_column_exceptions with pattern comparison_boundary, reserve at least one generated row per listed literal (exact value, no near-variant substitution); for numeric-typed columns accept non-numeric boundary literals as text values (declared type is loose).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share_reconciliation: For columns whose compact NULL share exceeds 30% (e.g. current.ballotpedia_id 0.359, current.middle_name 0.601, historical.middle_name 0.299), use the compact share as the NULL share; the 5-30% target applies only to columns whose compact share lies in that band. Every nullable column gets at least one NULL row per instance.
generic_sampling_rules.append_only: Each instance is the compact database copied unchanged plus appended generated rows; compact rows are never deleted or modified; generated rows per table must be > 0 for every table named in a formula.

uncertainty: current.cspan_id is declared NOT NULL in the schema but statistics show null_rate 0.22; treated as nullable in generation to match observed data.
current-terms.end is declared NOT NULL but statistics show null_rate 0.014; treated as nullable.
historical-terms.end and start are declared NOT NULL; start <= end order rule holds on all shown rows.
No formula relates current.bioguide_id to historical.bioguide_id; they are independent identifier spaces.
social-media.bioguide is a foreign key to current.bioguide_id but only 479 of 541 current rows have social-media children; parent rows without children are generated.
current-terms.bioguide is a foreign key to current.bioguide_id; parent rows without children are generated.
historical-terms.bioguide is a foreign key to historical.bioguide_id; one-to-one in the sample.

Enum domains for state_rank, class, title, religion_bio, gender_bio are inferred from observed data, not declared in DDL; treated as sampled-from-observed-with-fresh-values rather than hard constraints, except where a comparison_boundary exception pins specific literals.

SQLite FK validation requires current(bioguide_id) to be UNIQUE; the compact schema must declare it UNIQUE (or use composite FKs) and the generator must replay the same DDL so foreign_key_check passes.
The writer must copy the compact database (orig_path) and append generated rows; the call path must pass orig_path so compact rows are preserved unchanged.
